Questions

How do I order?

Tap “+ Add to order” on what you like, open your order, and send it to us on WhatsApp. We reply to confirm.

Do you deliver?

Choose Delivery or Pickup in your order and tell us your area. We confirm the options with you on WhatsApp.

How much does it cost?

Message us and we will send the price for each item and how to pay before anything is sent.

Is everything in stock?

Stock can change, so we confirm availability when you message us.

Who can buy soju?

Buyers must be 18 or older.
